name: Sumitomo Chemical Company, Limited
summary: Sumitomo Chemical Company, Limited engages in Agro & Life Solutions, ICT & Mobility Solutions, Advanced Medical Solutions, Essential & Green Materials, and Sumitomo Pharma.
